name: zclass_find_next_by_type_prefix_predicate
description: zClass::FindNextByTypePrefix_Predicate accepts nodes whose leading name bytes match the saved prefix text and prefix length.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this predicate; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f720 validates calling strncmp with the node name storage, g_zClass_FilterIterText, and g_zClass_FilterIterPrefixLen, then returning 1 only for a zero compare result.
The native smoke verifies prefix-filtered iteration returns only nodes whose names start with the requested prefix.
